description_for_human: DevTools you can talk to — drive your real browser through any MCP client.
description_for_model: Local session-bridge API the browser extension attaches to. The agent surface is MCP over stdio (npx @t3ratech/mcp-session-bridge); this manifest documents the local HTTP control channel.

auth.instructions: The bridge is loopback-only and pairing-gated by the extension; no remote credentials exist.
